# Supported languages

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the formatter descriptors. Do not edit by hand. -->

CodeNeat formats every language with a real, language-aware formatting engine. **Bundled** engines work immediately. **External** engines are the official formatter of that language, which you install once; CodeNeat detects it and tells you how to install it when it is missing.

The *Verified* column is deliberately strict: it says whether the real engine was executed against this repository's fixture for that language in the release test run (`npm run test:integration`). "Not executed" means the adapter is implemented and its command-line mapping is unit-tested, but the engine itself was not installed on the machine that ran the release tests. Run the integration tests on a machine with the tool installed to verify it yourself.
